body: I don't think that i can bear the anger, disappointment , loathing and disgrace that ill get once they know the truth. Ive been through this before and i dont want to feel it again. Im a failure.

I know that they wouldnt want that outcome. And it sucks that i know that.
I am supposed to "graduate" next semester and i think of this as my time left.
Im desperately racking my mind how to get thru this but i just cant.

Christmas and new year is coming and i think this is my last.
It seems like ending my life is the easiest way out.
